title: pouteria cayennensis
intro: Pouteria cayennensis, commonly known as Cayenne cherry, is a plant species from the family Sapotaceae. It is a medicinal plant known for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, helping to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria cayennensis include analgesic, anti-ulcerative, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating pain, ulcers, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
